g.text: I3: every required check passed on the head commit
Read the login of the Reviewer App
and the last cumin/status/ready of the issue
Count the round from the reviews on GitHub
I10: hand back to the Owner
Retry once in a new session,
then hand back to the Owner (row I3)
Latest review of the Reviewer is on the head
Ask once more in the same session
I5: change the label to cumin/status/implementing
Ask the Implementer to fix the comments
(its own session, the branch of the pull request)
I2, the checks, and I3 again
Log it (I8 is the next issue)
Hand back to the Owner (row I5)
yes, or no for the second time
